comun.sinRespuesta: Could not reach the server. Please check your connection and try again.

login.ayuda: Enter your credentials to access the system.
login.ayudaEmpresa: Your account is enabled in more than one. The information you see belongs to the one you select.
login.panelTexto: Each company works with its own information, its own lists and its own documents.

nuevaPassword.ayuda: For security reasons, you must set a new password to continue.
nuevaPassword.actualAyuda: The one you used to sign in.

miembros.ayuda: The people who work at this company and the roles they operate with.
miembros.buscar: Search by name, username or email
miembros.sinRolAyuda: Without a role, this person can sign in but cannot see any screen.
miembros.passwordTemporalAyuda: They have not set their own password yet.
miembros.sinMiembros: No users in this list yet
miembros.sinMiembrosAyuda: People who work at this company will appear here.
miembros.sinResultadosAyuda: Try another part of the name, username or email.
miembros.altaAyuda: Start with the email: if the person already works in your organization, they are added without creating them again.
miembros.yaTrabajaAcaAyuda: There is no need to add them again. Their roles are managed from their profile.
miembros.existeEnOrganizacionAyuda: Already registered in your organization. They are added to this company with the same account and password.
miembros.noExiste: No one in your organization has that email
miembros.noExisteAyuda: Fill in their details to add them.
miembros.usuarioAyuda: They can sign in with this name or with their email.
miembros.passwordGenerarAyuda: Recommended: the system creates one that is easy to read aloud.
miembros.passwordEscribirAyuda: They will still have to change it on first sign-in.
miembros.rolesAyuda: Optional. Without a role, the person can sign in but sees no screen.
miembros.sinRolesDisponibles: This company has no roles yet.
miembros.temporalAyuda: Shown only once. Give it to {{nombre}} through a secure channel: they must change it on first sign-in.
miembros.noCopiada: Could not copy. Select it and copy it manually.
miembros.noExisteFicha: The profile could not be opened
miembros.editarDatosAyuda: Changes apply to every company where they work: there is a single account.
miembros.resetearAyuda: A temporary password is generated and all their sessions are closed. They must change it on their next sign-in.
miembros.bajaAyuda: They stop working at this company. Nothing is deleted: it can be reactivated, and their other companies do not change.
miembros.cuentaActivaAyuda: With an active account they can sign in to every company where they work.
miembros.cuentaDesactivadaAyuda: With a deactivated account they cannot sign in to any company in your organization.
miembros.desactivarAyuda: They will not be able to sign in to any company in your organization, not just this one. It can be reactivated.
miembros.rolesFichaAyuda: What this person can do at this company.
miembros.asignarRolAyuda: The role is added to the ones they already have.
miembros.sinRolesParaAsignar: They already have every available role.
miembros.quitarRolAyuda: The assignment is not deleted: it stays in the history with its end date.

paginacion.topeAyuda: Only the first {{max}} records can be browsed. Use the filters to reach older ones.

listas.ayuda: The catalogs that fill the dropdown lists across the system.

entidades.ayuda: Customers, suppliers and other people or organizations the company works with. Each one is registered only once, even if it is both a customer and a supplier.
entidades.sinEntidadesAyuda: Customers, suppliers and other parties registered in this company will appear here.
entidades.noExisteAyuda: It may have been deactivated, or the link may be incorrect.
entidades.rolesAyuda: The same person or organization can be a customer and a supplier at the same time.
entidades.direccionTextoAyuda: For example: half a block from the central market
entidades.bajaRolAyuda: The record is not deleted: the person or organization stops acting in that capacity.
entidades.bajaDireccionAyuda: The address is deactivated, not deleted: documents that already used it will still show it.
entidades.tipoRolFijo: The role type cannot be changed. To assign a different one, deactivate this role and add a new one.
entidades.bajaEntidadAyuda: The record is not deleted: it becomes inactive and still appears in the list with that status.
entidades.regimenTributarioAyuda: Only for those who pay taxes in the country.
entidades.bajaContactoAyuda: The contact is not deleted: it moves to inactive status and is still listed with that status.

categorias.ayuda: Groups used to classify customers by their commercial relationship: wholesale, retail, VIP. Each company defines its own.
categorias.ayudaDialogo: Each company defines its own categories.
categorias.descuentoAyuda: As a percentage. If left empty, no discount applies.
categorias.sinCategoriasAyuda: Until at least one exists, no category can be assigned when registering a customer.
categorias.bajaAyuda: It stops showing up when assigning categories. Customers who already have it are not modified.

roles.ayuda: The sets of permissions assigned to the people in this company.
roles.heredadoAyuda: Defined at head office and used by all its branches. Only head office can modify it.
roles.sinRolesAyuda: Create a role to group the permissions each job position needs.
roles.sinResultadosAyuda: Please review the text entered or try another status filter.
roles.crearAyuda: It is created with no permissions. You may then define what its holders can do.
roles.editarAyuda: Change the name shown in the lists.
roles.campoNombreAyuda: It should name the job position, not the person.
roles.darDeBajaAyuda: It will no longer be available to assign. It cannot be deactivated while someone still holds it.
roles.permisosAyuda: Select what the holders of this role can do. Each change is saved immediately.
roles.permisosAyudaHeredado: This role is defined at head office. Here it can only be reviewed.
roles.sinPermisos: This role has no permissions yet
roles.sinPermisosAyuda: Select the ones the job position needs. With no permissions, its holders can sign in but see no screen.
roles.sinPermisosHeredadoAyuda: Head office has not yet defined what the holders of this role can do.
roles.sinResultadosPermisoAyuda: Please try another part of the name, or the code.
roles.fueraDeAlcanceAyuda: This role holds this permission, but you do not have it and therefore cannot remove it.
